paragraphs: Itron sells metering and grid technology for electricity, gas and water, and its homepage names utilities and cities as the customers it builds for. The product menu separates smart electricity management, smart gas management and smart water solutions, with advanced metering infrastructure and meter data management listed underneath. Network and software offerings sit beside the meters, among them communication networks, distribution automation, grid edge management and distributed energy resource management.

The homepage lists cities, municipalities and fleet operators beside electric, gas, water, combo and cooperative utilities as the segments it serves. A partner locator publishes third party products that connect to Itron networks, including a battery powered natural gas alarm listed as compatible with one of them. Those listed products include street lighting controllers, power quality monitoring, underground cable monitoring and traffic detection.

quote.text: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water
